scripts.dev:ui: pnpm run codegen && pnpm --filter bolomj360_ui dev
scripts.codegen: pnpm --filter bolomj360_api schema:print && pnpm --filter bolomj360_ui codegen
scripts.build: pnpm run codegen && pnpm --filter bolomj360_api build && pnpm --filter bolomj360_ui build
scripts.check: pnpm run codegen && pnpm --filter bolomj360_api check && pnpm --filter bolomj360_ui check
